resources.string: Protect your privacy across all your apps
Only the trackers from the biggest networks (Google, Unity, AppLovin). Maximum compatibility: won\'t break apps.
Most trackers from apps and games (ironSource, Vungle, Mintegral and more). Best for everyday use.
Ad trackers + analytics and telemetry (AppsFlyer, Adjust…). Maximum blocking; may affect some apps.
Keep the notice in the status bar
Local VPN: it doesn\'t send your data anywhere, it only filters DNS on your phone. The key icon in the status bar belongs to Android and can\'t be removed while the filter is on.
